content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

In the next 24 hours, you can deploy a fully operational digital commerce stack. This isn’t a theoretical exercise—it’s actionable infrastructure. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free), Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic (free), and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage (free). File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is automatic via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Your customers pay in USDT, USDC, or Bitcoin. You receive payment directly to your wallet. No intermediaries. No geographic restrictions. This stack is live in hours, not weeks.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is your entry point. It includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. We load three products for you and provide 30-day support. For more advanced needs, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. It includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. Both stacks are deployed in 48 hours. You own the infrastructure after deployment. COREMERCH has no access. No platform locks you in. This is not a rental—it’s ownership.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what’s critical: payment processing, file delivery, and order storage. Skip non-essential features like custom domains, advanced analytics, or email marketing integrations. These can be added later. The priority is getting your first transaction live. Use NOWPayments for crypto processing—it’s the fastest path to revenue. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, or TRON (under $0.10 per transaction). Avoid Ethereum for now due to high gas fees. Your stack is lean, fast, and operational today.
Deploy your commerce stack in 48 hours. No geographic barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Deploy the stack, load your first product, and test the payment flow. Use a test wallet to simulate a purchase. Verify that the webhook fires when payment confirms on-chain. File delivery should trigger automatically. Once tested, share your store link with your audience. Your first sale is proof of concept. From there, scale by adding more products or upgrading your stack. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant download. It’s the fastest way to build a sovereign commerce infrastructure.

You’re building your own payment gateway. Your customers pay in crypto. You deliver products instantly. Geographic barriers are removed entirely.
